study.research_question: Can each engine distinguish supported, contradicted and insufficient evidence on identical authored snapshots?
study.research_gap: Natural task outcomes do not establish matched-state judgment accuracy or negative-state discrimination.
study.hypothesis: Both engines exactly classify all three authored states and project the intended repair branch.

primary_metric.name: jev_minus_llm_exact_verdict_accuracy
primary_metric.aggregation: (Jev exact-label matches - LLM exact-label matches) / 3 paired authored states

study.decision_rule: Descriptive component diagnostic only. No promotion, adoption, publication or release authority.
study.invalidation_rule: Any missing, transport, contract, observation, source or digest-invalid call stops dispatch and makes the primary not measurable. Wrong valid labels remain failures.
study.analysis_plan: Show all three paired labels, native answers, projected branches, per-call timing, token presence and separate price estimates. These are three counterfactual variants of one task: no IID confidence interval, calibration or pooled E2E denominator. Preserve invalid and failed consumption.

environment.reset_strategy: Fresh process and isolated GEODE home/state; no root, tools or mutable task world

comparison.comparator: Astra subscription typed verdict versus direct TypeSafe Jev typed verdict

privacy.redaction_boundary: Native answers, events, usage and local paths stay private pending exact-byte review. No credential values or headers. Billing is unknown; fixed feedback is not model reasoning.
